title: Prepare cover and a retreat near camp
applies_when: The settlement needs protection or a threat is approaching.
approach: Equip capable pawns with suitable available weapons. Check violence incapability before trying again after an equip failure.
Choose nearby cover with a clear firing direction and a safe retreat. Existing walls and chunks can help before purpose-built defenses are finished.
Keep civilian routes away from traps and known hazards. Assess what threatens the camp or a work route; distant insects do not automatically stop all construction.
During an actual attack, withdraw exposed workers and position defenders. Do not send lone pawns across the map to engage stationary cave threats.
verify: Threat location and behavior, weapon range, line of fire, cover and retreat route.
reconsider: Raiders bypass the position, fire spreads, or injured defenders need to withdraw.
